summary: ITER185 CRM Foundation Phase 1 — full backend + frontend test. Backend pytest 22/22 PASS (test_iter185_crm_foundation.py). Fast Capture chips picker, phone-only path, validation gating, and source 'other' detail conditional all work. AccountsPage Convert/Revert CTAs render correctly per lifecycle stage. CRITICAL bug found and fixed: LeadsPage.jsx crashed on load due to 3 missing imports (DesignerChip, Link, BookOpen) — page is now functional. Two remaining concerns for main agent: (1) After Fast Capture submit user lands on /dashboard instead of LeadDetailPage so live Discovery Progress widget couldn't be verified end-to-end in browser; (2) ~3 i18n missing keys per page (Editorial debug bar runtime 3 · missing 3).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester — runtime crash 'DesignerChip/Link/BookOpen is not defined' due to 3 missing imports. Added: import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import DesignerChip from './DesignerChip'; and BookOpen to lucide-react import. Page now renders 33 Leads correctly.

After successful Fast Capture submission the app navigates to /dashboard rather than /relations/leads/{id} (LeadDetailPage). Per acceptance criteria, submit should land on LeadDetailPage so the user can immediately work on Discovery. As a result, in-app navigation flow is broken AND the in-LeadDetailPage Discovery Progress widget couldn't be exercised live in browser. Toast 'Lead creato' was not visually verified either.

Lead cards on /relations/leads do not expose <a href="/relations/leads/{id}"> link — likely button+useNavigate. Makes deep-linking/automation harder. Recommend wrapping card content in a <Link> for accessibility and testability.

Console warning repeated on every route: 'Cannot update a component (LocalizationOverlay) while rendering a different component (LoginPage / Sidebar)'. setState-in-render pattern needs to be moved into useEffect.
EDITORIAL · DEBUG bar reports 'runtime 3 · missing 3' on /relations/accounts and 'missing 16' on /dashboard. Some keys aren't resolved at runtime in it-IT locale.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/leads/fast-capture returns 201 (verified via pytest) but frontend onCreated handler redirects to /dashboard instead of LeadDetailPage. Discovery Progress widget therefore not displayed to the user after fast-capture.
Multiple 401/403/503 errors logged on /dashboard for resource fetches. Need triage whether these are graceful optional features or required endpoints with auth misalignment.

rca_of_the_issue: LeadsPage.jsx crash RCA: LeadCard JSX referenced DesignerChip, Link and BookOpen but the file only imported {Search, X, Plus} from lucide-react and useDesigners hook. Three identifiers were undefined at render time → ReferenceError caught by React's error boundary which shows the 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Fix: added the three missing imports. Reproduction: login as admin → click sidebar Leads / navigate to /relations/leads → page shows red 'Uncaught runtime errors' panel. Mitigation: yarn build + ESLint no-undef rule should be required pre-commit.
